breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between the two specified time integration methods. The ground truth resolves the conflict by removing the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction and keeping only the detailed 'Strang splitting' method. The agent, however, incorrectly combined the two conflicting instructions into the phrase 'Implement Strang splitting time integration with explicit forward Euler', which does not match the ground truth and perpetuates the error.
